content: Radlinski/Kurup/Joachims CIKM 2008 (dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/1458082.1458092 + Cornell PDF): none of 8 absolute click/usage metrics reliably reflected retrieval quality at realistic sample sizes; balanced/team-draft interleaving gave accurate, consistent, significantly more sensitive RELATIVE judgments. Bendersky et al. IJCAI 2018 (ijcai.org/Proceedings/2018/725): personal-search implicit feedback is highly sparse and biased. Implication for SIF single-user: no absolute CTR/abandonment quality gates; use paired per-query deltas / known-item outcomes; query_log (CLI-only, 500-row cap, MCP never writes) is a suggestion source not an eval oracle.
